Very good for the price
Apr 2019 • Solo
I ordered the butter chicken and garlic nan and a banana lassi for a total of 115k and I was stuffed afterwards! I have had better Indian food in other countries but for being in Vietnam I wasn't expecting much and this was pretty decent and a good price and friendly staff. I liked that I got to choose if my chicken is boneless or not and I asked for medium spice and it was the perfect amount of spice for me. Definitely recommend if you are in this area looking for cheap and filling Indian food

new cook, great food, great value
Nov 2018 • Solo
Had been to Taste of India many times in the past year while in Saigon. Returned 10 days ago and a new cook had just started. Have gotten take-out 5 of the last ten nights and it's been great each time. Masalas both veg and meat are great, dahi chicken and mutton, several types of dal. Everything has been very good and more reasonable than better known Pham Ngu Lao Indian places. Highly recommended!
